clues.text: Adam gave his wife this name because she would be the mother of all the living.
She bore Cain and said that with the help of the LORD she had brought forth a man.
She later gave birth to Cain's brother, a keeper of sheep whose offering the LORD favored.
After the curses in Eden, the LORD God made garments of skin and clothed her and her husband.
Paul feared the Corinthians might be led astray, just as she was deceived by the serpent's cunning.
Writing to Timothy, Paul said Adam was formed first, and then she was formed.
God cursed the ground because Adam listened to her voice and ate from the forbidden tree.
